gap: L. Budget LAUNCH_SAME_COPY_MS 400 stays (lead's ruling). Measured phases (main100 launch.log, same copy, hidden rig, Debug; perf/launch.py `launch: phase` lines): app-init 39.5 ms after process start; NSApplication's own start 486.4 (app-init to nsapp-made, AppKit: no app code runs); the hidden copy's set-up 2.6 (taken off); commands-body to root-state-init 132.0 (SwiftUI making the window; no app code); then the app's views: split-hosts-made to list-body 92.6 (the sidebar pane), list 26.7, reader 16.1, dividers and appearance about 30; the judged launch (842) is first-appear. Built (perf-archive rounds 6-7): the hidden search dropdown is built after the first frame (InboxListView.swift), the sidebar reads the outbox once per evaluation instead of four times (SidebarView.swift), a `sidebar-body` mark splits the 92.6. Left: (1) the lead's run of the next build with the new marks; (2) the 400 ms budget is below AppKit's own start on this machine (486.4 ms before any app view exists): no app change can meet it while that holds; a Release build and a quiet machine are the remaining levers (launch-r1 proposal 5), the owner or the lead decides; (3) whatever the sidebar mark names inside its 92.6 ms.
owner: The owner says whether the installed main bundle is a Release build (docs/lanes/launch-r1.md proposal 5): the 400 ms row cannot be met by a Debug build (phases 3-5 alone about 500 ms).
